adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a `raw_html` cook method where `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim (app/models/post.rb), bypassing the normal cooking pipeline and `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)`. New import paths explicitly set `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (TopicEmbed.import via PostCreator) and render via `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), so any HTML in imported content is treated as safe. The RSS polling job decodes entities with `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), which can turn escaped tags into live markup before storage. Additionally, TopicEmbed.import interpolates `url` directly into a single-quoted `<a href='#{url}'>` footer without escaping (app/models/topic_embed.rb); the only validation is `^https?://`, which does not prevent quote-breaking payloads. The readability import only whitelists tag/attribute names (href/src) without any visible URI-scheme sanitization, so `javascript:` links in doc.content would survive and be rendered as raw HTML.
